//: Phase 2: PicoRV32 hardened alone (no SRAM), project-plan.md §8. Run with `make harden-core`; paths are relative to the repo root (run.sh passes --design-dir). Settings are explained in README.md next to this file.
//SYNTH_PARAMETERS: Must equal the parameters of u_cpu in rtl/soc/soc_top.v; run.sh checks this before the flow (pnr/picorv32_core/cpu_params.py).
//CORNERS: LibreLane's sky130 default only fails setup in the tt corners; Phase 2 exit needs setup and hold clean in all 9 corners.
//EXTRA_EXCLUDED_CELLS: The PDK exclude list (drc_exclude.cells) excludes only clkdlybuf4s15_1 and clkdlybuf4s18_1; without this the resizer used clkdlybuf4s25_1 as its general buffer (port, fanout buffers) and max slew failed. See README.md.
//CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_SIZE: CTS chose 10 sinks per leaf buffer and then added dummy loads, giving leaf fanout 11-12 > MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT 10. See README.md.
//LAYERS_RC: Per-layer wire R (kOhm/um) and C (pF/um) for pre-route parasitic estimates. Without it OpenROAD derives C from the tech LEF (about 0.08 fF/um), half of what RCX extracts after routing (0.178 fF/um average), so the resizer under-repairs slew/cap. Values: the sky130 table left commented out in LibreLane 3.0.14 librelane/config/pdk_compat.py lines 262-296. See README.md.
//RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR: Repairs slew/cap again after global routing. The only other repair runs after global placement, before CTS; about 2200 hold buffers and routing add load afterwards. LibreLane marks it experimental (may hang or run long); here the step takes about 25 s. See README.md.
//GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_SLEW_PCT: Slew margin of that repair (default 10 %); 10 % left 2 nets above 0.75 ns in max_ss after detailed routing. See README.md.
//CTS_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_BUFFERS: CTS buffers only the long H-tree levels; without this the 4 level-2 clock buffers each drove 16 buffers (> MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT 10), two of them 0.206 and 0.203 pF (> MAX_CAPACITANCE_CONSTRAINT 0.2 pF), through an unbuffered wire tree. 50 um adds buffers inside that tree (max clock-buffer fanout 9). See README.md.
